result.reason: The new clause reaches the preferred position by providing up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, a machine-readable data return within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter. However, it unnecessarily extends the return and deletion obligations to all Confidential Information and Works. Requiring Works to be returned within 30 days regardless of payment may also conflict with section 6(c), which conditions delivery and assignment of works in progress on final payment. “Company data” should also be defined or aligned with the playbook’s “Customer Data,” and the deletion timing should account for any ongoing transition period.
